description: #4 is my favorite! Did you know these tricks for making perfect no spread sugar cookies? #sugarcookierecipe #valentinesdayrecipes #bakingtips #cookiedecorating #sugargeekshow
transcript: So if you want to make sugar cookies that are soft and don't spread it's actually not a special recipe it's in a couple of techniques that I'm going to show you right now. So the first thing is that when we cream the butter and sugar you want to cream it way more than you think you need to. It needs to be light and fluffy like this so that when you add in the egg it is able to make an emulsion. An emulsion just means that everything is mixed together evenly so that when it starts baking the eggs and the liquid don't separate from the butter. Next we're going to add in our flour baking powder. I have a little bit of nutmeg in here, some salt, and I'm going to add that in in two parts and this just helps the flour absorb any liquid that is from the eggs or the vanilla. If you dump it in all at once then you can't really like mix the flour in with the liquid ingredients as well. The third tip is that when you're mixing the flour and the eggs and everything you want to add milk at the very end. This also helps the flour absorb into the other ingredients. So if you have a sugar cookie that you like already like a recipe that you like already try seeing if any of these tips help you with the no spread. The last tip is when you're chilling your dough. This is an important step because it helps the flour merge with the liquids again and helps prevent spreading. I'm going to take my plastic wrap and make a square around the dough and roll it to the thickness that you want your cookies to be so that when you chill it you don't have to roll it again. And this keeps all of the dough together and all you have to do is just go straight to the cutting. It makes these beautiful perfect super sharp edges and you can just bake them right away you don't have to chill them again. So not only does it work really well but it also saves you some time. Look at these beautiful cookies. Recipe on the blog.
